hint: ผมมั่นใจว่า EKG นี้เป็น STEMI เฉียบพลัน

parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, normal axis, upright T waves and a flat isoelectric ST segment in all leads, so there is no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria and no reciprocal ST depression, which does not support acute STEMI.
